class ProgramRevisionInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    id: UUID = Field(default_factory=uuid4)
    expected_revision: int = Field(ge=0)
    summary: str = Field(default='', max_length=1000)
    policy_snapshot: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50000)
    sources: list[ProgramSource] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    verified_at: AwareDatetime | None = None
    verified_fact: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=1000)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def explicit_verification(self):
        if (self.verified_at is None) != (self.verified_fact is None):
            raise ValueError('verified_at and verified_fact must be supplied together')
        if not self.policy_snapshot.strip() or (self.verified_fact is not None and not self.verified_fact.strip()):
            raise ValueError('Policy and verification facts must contain text')
        return self
